title: Health Resort east wing room 216 key

infobox.usage: This key has no usage. Room 216 is always unlocked.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Health Resort east wing room 216 key (E216 San) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the Azure Coast sanatorium east wing room 216.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- The room is always open.
- Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The second floor, room 216 of the West Wing in the Health Resort on Shoreline.
